思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S22 「搜索状态的无障碍：输入了搜索、没有匹配的提示被读出、All Residents」 Accessibility of the search states: search typed, no-match message announced, All Residents

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 2；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane fixture, both contexts

When Run axe on /rounding and /snf with a search typed, with a no-match search, and on NH All Residents; check that the no-match message is announced

Then No serious/critical violations in any of these states. The no-match message is a status message (role=status or aria-live), so a screen reader announces it (WCAG 4.1.3). Clear search has an accessible name

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core serious/critical = 0 per state, plus a DOM check that the no-match paragraph sits in a role=status / aria-live region (axe does not test 4.1.3). Ticket snapshot and risks predict a Fail on the live-region check

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92581 ready for qa

搜索没有结果时，「No patients match …」/「No residents match …」不会被读出来，读屏用户什么都听不到；每个搜索状态下也都有同样的对比度和按钮没名字的问题。

When a search finds nothing, 'No patients match …' or 'No residents match …' is not announced, so a screen-reader user hears nothing; the same contrast and unnamed-button problems show in every search state.

依据：visual lane: 6 pass, 21 fail across 3 devices. The no-match paragraph is not in a role=status/aria-live region (WCAG 4.1.3), as the oracle predicted. Clear search is named correctly.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）（VISUAL (axe per search state plus a DOM check for role=status/aria-live)）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。
